# reado

> reado is a web application for reading habit formation and reading gamification. It helps people who struggle with reading consistency, reading anxiety, and ADHD-related reading interruptions.

## Product summary

- Product: reado
- URL: https://reado.fun/
- App URL: https://reado.fun/pages/playable-studio.html
- Blog URL: https://reado.fun/blog/
- Type: Educational web application

## Core use cases

- reading anxiety reduction via short, finishable reading missions
- struggle in reading consistency with habit loops and progress visibility
- reading gamification with levels, quests, and restart-friendly workflows
- guidance on how to read more books without burnout
- guidance on how to read books with adhd using continuity design
